description: Free-tier endpoint. Every market each book is pricing on a sport's games in the next N days, and on how many of those games. Returns the game count and, per book, game_lines and props entries {market, period, events, markets, last_update}. Useful for: 'which books have NFL player props posted', 'does FanDuel price this market yet'. Books post props at different times, so a low events count means not posted on every game yet.

days.description: Games starting in the next N days, 1-7. Defaults to 3.

periods.description: Include quarter / half / inning markets. Defaults to false.

name: propline_get_market_coverage
title: Get market coverage by book
